segments.name: Regional airline services
segments.description: Provides scheduled regional passenger flight capacity to major airline partners under multi-year capacity purchase agreements.
segments.evidence: The Company is organized and operates as one operating and reportable segment: regional airline services.

revenueModel.text: The Partner Airlines pay Republic fixed amounts specified under CPAs, including fixed monthly payments per aircraft and payments per block hour or flight, while retaining all passenger and cargo revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: the Partner Airlines retain all the revenue from the passengers and cargo aboard Republic's flights and, in exchange, pay Republic the fixed amounts specified under Republic's CPAs.

changes.text: In November 2025, Republic Airways Holdings merged with and into Mesa Air Group, with Mesa Parent continuing as the surviving corporation and renamed Republic Airways Holdings Inc.
changes.evidence: On November 25, 2025, Legacy Republic completed the Merger with Mesa Parent with the Mesa Parent legal entity continuing as the surviving corporation.
